dxgive.evidence_source: [/page/19/Text/3] Our outcome measure was CDI score at Time 3. Our independent variables were entered by set. They included Time 1 depression score (Set 1), age and gender (Set 2), family income and parental education (Set 3), parental conflict (CPIC; Set 4), academic performance (school grades) and school conduct (CCQ; Set 5).

Source.evidence_source: [/page/19/Text/3] Our outcome measure was CDI score at Time 3. [/page/19/Table/6] Note. CDI1 is the depression score at time 1 and CDI3 is the depression score eight months later.
